project_meta.title: What If Every Human Could Fly?

global_style.art_style: Minimalist hand-drawn stickman storytelling with cinematic imaginative visuals. Warm off-white paper texture, bold slightly imperfect black ink outlines, limited earthy accent colors, soft blue skies and warm orange sunlight. All human characters have round white faces, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes of identical size and spacing, no pupils, irises, eye whites, highlights, reflections or eyelashes, simple curved mouths and thin black stick limbs. The recurring presenter always has a small red bow tie. Keep identical eye design and character proportions across every image. Dynamic aerial perspectives, expressive poses, clear silhouettes, imaginative but believable everyday environments, vertical 9:16 composition.
global_style.negative_prompt: No photorealism, no 3D rendering, no realistic anatomy, no detailed human faces, no changing eye styles, no pupils, no irises, no eye whites, no highlights, no reflections, no eyelashes, no extra eyes, no wings growing from human bodies, no superhero costumes, no text, no watermarks, no logos, no cluttered compositions.

commuter.visual_dna: A simple stickman with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, thin black stick limbs, a blue shirt, dark trousers and a small backpack. No detailed facial features.

child.label: Flying child
child.visual_dna: A small cartoon stickman child with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, thin black stick limbs, a yellow shirt and shorts. No detailed facial features.

delivery_worker.label: Flying delivery worker
delivery_worker.visual_dna: A simple stickman with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, thin black stick limbs, an orange delivery jacket and a compact delivery backpack. No detailed facial features.

city.label: Modern flying city
city.visual_dna: A modern city with skyscrapers, apartment buildings, roads, parks, rooftop platforms and people flying between buildings. Minimalist hand-drawn black outlines, warm paper texture and muted colors.

beats.narration_text: सोचो, अगर दुनिया का हर इंसान बिना पंखों के उड़ सकता?
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 cinematic hand-drawn illustration of the recurring stickman presenter floating high above a modern city, looking down at skyscrapers and tiny flying people everywhere. The presenter has a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites, highlights or reflections, a simple curved mouth, thin black stick limbs and a small red bow tie. Warm off-white paper, bold black ink outlines, bright blue sky, dramatic sunlight.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Establish the extraordinary premise: ordinary people can fly naturally without wings or machines. Keep the presenter design consistent.

beats.narration_text: ना हवाई जहाज़, ना ट्रैफिक जाम, बस घर से उड़ो और सीधे अपनी मंज़िल पर पहुँच जाओ।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 bird's-eye view of a busy modern city. Cars are stuck in a long traffic jam on the roads, while dozens of ordinary stickman people fly freely above the buildings toward different destinations. Every human has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites, highlights or reflections. Warm paper texture, bold black ink outlines, muted blue and orange accents.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Create a clear contrast between crowded roads and open aerial movement.

beats.narration_text: सुबह ऑफिस जाने के लिए लोग बस बालकनी से छलाँग लगाते और हवा में आगे बढ़ जाते।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 hand-drawn scene of a commuter stepping carefully off an apartment balcony and beginning to float into the sky, smiling with arms slightly extended. The commuter has a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights, blue shirt, dark trousers and a small backpack. Modern apartment building, bright morning sunlight, bold black outlines, off-white paper texture.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show controlled, effortless flight rather than a dangerous uncontrolled fall.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन कुछ ही दिनों में हमारी पूरी दुनिया बदल जाती।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 dramatic view from a city street looking upward at hundreds of people flying between tall buildings, crossing above roads and landing on rooftops. Some carry briefcases, backpacks and shopping bags. Every stickman has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights. Warm sunlight, hand-drawn black ink outlines, dynamic sky composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make the city feel alive with flight becoming an ordinary part of daily life.

beats.narration_text: सबसे पहले, सड़कों पर गाड़ियों की ज़रूरत बहुत कम हो सकती थी।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 wide hand-drawn city road with very few cars and buses, while people fly above the road in different directions. A commuter with a blue shirt and backpack floats past a traffic signal. All characters have exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights. Warm off-white paper, bold black ink outlines, muted colors.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show fewer vehicles but retain some ground transport for people and goods.

beats.narration_text: पार्किंग की जगहें खाली होतीं और शहरों की सड़कों का नक्शा बदल जाता।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 high-angle hand-drawn view of a city where an old parking lot has been transformed into a green public park with trees, benches and walking paths. A few people fly above the park. Every human has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights. Warm sunlight, off-white paper, bold black ink outlines, earthy green accents.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Visualize one possible use for land freed from excessive parking.

beats.narration_text: दूर रहने वाले दोस्त और परिवार भी कुछ ही मिनटों में एक-दूसरे से मिल सकते।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 warm hand-drawn scene of two stickman friends flying toward each other above a small neighborhood, arms open for a friendly greeting. Both have round white faces with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights. One wears a blue shirt, the other a mustard jacket. Soft afternoon sunlight, warm paper texture, bold black outlines.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Focus on the emotional benefit of easier visits and connection.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन आसमान भी धीरे-धीरे सड़कों जितना व्यस्त हो जाता।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 aerial view of a busy sky filled with people flying in different directions between buildings, some carrying bags and briefcases. Their paths nearly intersect, with a few simple floating directional arrows indicating traffic flow. Every character has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights. Bold black ink, off-white paper, muted blue sky.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce aerial congestion as an unexpected consequence of everyone flying.

beats.narration_text: इसलिए हवा में भी ट्रैफिक नियम, लेन और उड़ने की सीमाएँ बनानी पड़तीं।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 hand-drawn futuristic city sky with clearly separated aerial lanes marked by simple floating lines and arrows. People fly in orderly directions at different heights, while a small sky traffic control tower watches over them. Every human has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights. Clean bold ink outlines, warm paper texture, muted blue and orange colors.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show a practical organized flying system rather than a chaotic sky.

beats.narration_text: घर और इमारतें भी पहले जैसी नहीं बनतीं।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 hand-drawn architectural view of a modern apartment building with balconies, rooftop landing platforms and open sky access points. Several people hover near different floors. Every human has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights. Warm off-white paper, bold black outlines, muted earthy colors.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce how buildings might adapt to a population that can fly.

beats.narration_text: लोग खिड़कियों और बालकनी से सीधे अंदर आने लगते।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 interior view of a modern apartment living room. A stickman resident gently floats through a large open balcony doorway carrying a grocery bag. The resident has a round white face with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights, simple stick limbs and casual clothes. Warm sunlight enters through the window, hand-drawn black ink outlines.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show a normal home arrival through the balcony, keeping the action friendly and safe.

beats.narration_text: ऊँची मंज़िलों तक पहुँचने के लिए लिफ्ट का इंतज़ार भी शायद कम हो जाता।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 dramatic upward view of a tall apartment building with a long elevator queue visible through the lobby windows, while several residents fly upward along the outside of the building toward their balconies. Every human has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights. Bold hand-drawn outlines, warm paper texture, muted blue sky.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Use the contrast between the elevator queue and people flying outside to tell the story.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन बच्चों, बुज़ुर्गों और उड़ने में परेशानी वाले लोगों के लिए लिफ्ट फिर भी ज़रूरी रहती।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 thoughtful hand-drawn scene of an older stickman and a young child entering a spacious elevator while other residents fly outside the building. Both characters have round white faces with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights. Warm gentle lighting, bold black ink outlines, muted earthy colors.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show that accessible transport remains important even in a flying world.

beats.narration_text: डिलीवरी का काम भी पूरी तरह बदल जाता।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 dynamic hand-drawn scene of a flying delivery worker carrying a compact delivery backpack and a small parcel, gliding between city buildings. The worker has a round white face with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights, thin stick limbs and an orange jacket. Warm paper texture, bold black outlines, bright sky.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep the delivery worker's orange jacket and compact backpack consistent.

beats.narration_text: लोग सामान लेकर हवा में उड़ते और शायद कुछ डिलीवरी पहले से तेज़ हो जातीं।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 side view of the same flying delivery worker carrying a small parcel toward an apartment balcony. Below, a traditional delivery van moves along the road. The worker has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights, round white face and orange jacket. Hand-drawn black ink outlines, warm paper background.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Contrast a flying delivery route with a ground delivery van without implying every delivery becomes faster.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन भारी सामान, मशीनें और बड़े पार्सल फिर भी गाड़ियों से ही पहुँचाने पड़ते।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 hand-drawn logistics scene showing a delivery truck carrying a large refrigerator and furniture boxes along a city street. Above it, a delivery worker flies with only a small lightweight parcel. The worker has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights, round white face and orange jacket. Warm earthy colors, bold black outlines.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Clearly distinguish small personal deliveries from heavy freight that still needs vehicles.

beats.narration_text: और बारिश, तेज़ हवा या तूफ़ान में उड़ना खतरनाक भी हो सकता था।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 dramatic hand-drawn scene of a strong storm over a modern city. Dark clouds, slanted rain and wind lines fill the sky. A commuter wearing a blue shirt and backpack safely waits under a building shelter instead of flying. The commuter has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights. Bold black outlines, muted blue-grey colors, warm paper texture.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show that flying is weather-dependent and people need safe alternatives.

beats.narration_text: और सोचो, पहाड़, समुद्र और जंगल देखने का अनुभव कितना अलग होता।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 breathtaking hand-drawn aerial landscape of green mountains, a winding river, dense forests and a distant ocean. Several tiny stickman people fly high above the landscape, enjoying the view. Every character has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights. Warm golden sunlight, off-white paper texture, bold black ink outlines.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Create a beautiful sense of freedom and scale.

beats.narration_text: जहाँ पहुँचने में पहले घंटों लगते, वहाँ शायद सीधे उड़कर पहुँचा जा सकता।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 hand-drawn scene of a winding mountain road with a small car traveling slowly below, while a stickman traveler flies directly above the valley toward a mountain viewpoint. The traveler has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights, simple stick limbs and a small backpack. Warm sunset, bold ink outlines, muted green and blue palette.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the difference between a winding road and a direct aerial route.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन हर किसी के पास उड़ने की एक जैसी ताकत या क्षमता नहीं होती, तो बराबरी का सवाल भी उठता।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 thoughtful hand-drawn scene showing a group of stickman people flying together at different heights while one person stands comfortably on a rooftop platform using a safe elevator entrance. The standing person is included respectfully, not isolated. All characters have exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights. Warm paper texture, soft blue sky and earthy colors.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Raise the issue of different abilities and equal access without portraying anyone negatively.

beats.narration_text: शहरों को ऐसे बनाना पड़ता जहाँ उड़ने वाले और ज़मीन पर रहने वाले, दोनों आसानी से सफर कर सकें।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 panoramic hand-drawn futuristic city showing people flying in organized sky lanes, others walking on wide sidewalks, accessible elevators in buildings and buses on the roads. Every human has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights. Warm off-white paper, bold black outlines, muted green, blue and orange accents.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show an inclusive city designed for both flying and non-flying travel.

beats.narration_text: तो उड़ने की ताकत दुनिया को आज़ाद तो बनाती, लेकिन नई समस्याएँ भी लाती।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 cinematic view of a modern city skyline with people flying in organized aerial lanes, a few rooftop landing areas, ground vehicles and green parks. The recurring presenter floats in the foreground, looking thoughtfully at the transformed city. The presenter has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites, highlights or reflections, round white face and red bow tie. Warm golden light, hand-drawn ink outlines.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Bring together the benefits and challenges of a world where everyone can fly.

beats.narration_text: और अब बताओ, अगर तुम उड़ सकते, तो सबसे पहले कहाँ जाते?
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 close-up of the recurring presenter floating above the city with one hand raised, pointing toward three distant destinations visible in the sky: snowy mountains, a tropical beach and a glowing modern skyline. The presenter has a perfectly round white face with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites, highlights or reflections, a simple curved mouth, thin black stick limbs and a small red bow tie. Warm off-white paper texture, bold black ink outlines, inviting sunset atmosphere.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Finish with an inviting question and a visually exciting choice of destinations. Keep the presenter's exact eye design.
